items.title: 60499_Garvin Bushell oral history interview
items.q: So we had a Russian dancer, a little guy named George State, and he was a feather weight.

ctx.x: Yeah, professional, yeah. And I think Paulino -- I saw Paulino there, Paulino Scodoon. He was on one of the cards. Anyhow, one of the boxers didn't show up, so they said, 'We're one bout short.' So we had a Russian dancer, a little guy named George State, and he was a feather weight. He had done some pro boxing but he wasn't good enough, so he went back to doing dancing, Russian dancing -- knee drops and all that sort of thing. So, they said, 'We're short a bout.' So George said, 'I'll fight him.' 'Come on,…

was a middle weight and a heavy weight bout. This feather weight champion was supposed to box an exhibition bout with somebody and the guy didn't show up, I guess he got cold feet. George said, "I'll fight him."
